# NextDNS Provider

Manage [NextDNS](https://nextdns.io/) profiles with Terraform.

This provider is not affiliated with or endorsed by NextDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "nextdns" {
  api_key = var.nextdns_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key used to authenticate with NextDNS. Can also be set with the `NEXTDNS_API_KEY` environment variable. Get your key at https://my.nextdns.io/account.
